_source: Claude Code's own default look: Windows Terminal's built-in Campbell scheme for the ANSI colours and background, and Claude Code's dark-theme accents (Claude orange, the spinner blue, its success, warning and error colours). Used only for the PowerShell prompt and Rio; Claude Code itself runs its built-in dark theme and Windows Terminal its built-in Campbell scheme.
label: Claude Default
mood: Claude Code as it ships: neutral black, grey-white text, Claude orange, spinner blue
